slug: 2023-11-20 WB Ethiopia Digital ID for Inclusion and Services Project - project appraisal document

facts.fact: The World Bank appraisal document for the Ethiopia Digital ID for Inclusion and Services Project, financed in part by the Window for Host Communities and Refugees, sets an end-December 2028 project target of 924,000 refugees (and 1,700,000 people in refugee host communities) in the national Fayda digital ID results framework, with ID centres to serve nationals and nonnationals.

systems.owner: National ID Program (NIDP), Prime Minister's Office
